description: This file declares the interface for the FillSPMDExpander class, responsible for expanding and computing layouts for the 'fill' operation within the TensorFlow DTensor MLIR framework. It includes methods for expanding the computation and determining input/output layouts, and references MLIR and TensorFlow components.

classes.name: FillSPMDExpander
classes.description: A class inheriting from SPMDExpanderBase responsible for expanding the fill operation in the MLIR DTensor dialect and computing input/output layouts.

methods.name: ExpandOp
methods.description: Expands the given operation into a concrete implementation, potentially replacing it with more detailed MLIR operations.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutForward
methods.description: Computes input layouts based on the operation and output layouts, propagating layout information forward.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutBackward
methods.description: Computes output layouts based on the operation and input layouts, propagating layout information backward.
